packages.title: Capture errors: a refused recording waits with «Cerrar»; a failed save says it couldn't add
brief: Round 2 (b2). Two regressions from P173, both in `App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart`; neither has failed before. What P173 built, and review A verified (UX-1307 and UX-1318 fixed): `CaptureProblem.from` (`App/lib/services/capture_problem.dart:94-101`) tells the 429s apart (Retry-After of 120 s or less → `tooFast`, none → `unavailable`, otherwise `allowance`); `captureAllowance` now reads ES «Has llegado al límite de dictados de hoy. Toca Guardar como tarea o inténtalo mañana.»; and `_apply`'s catch (about :3492-3500) passes every `ApiException` through `CaptureProblem.from`. Keep all of that except what follows.

UX-1630 (R1A-1, S2). The daily limit's copy names «Guardar como tarea», but that button needs words (`saveAsWritten` = `_hasWords && …`, about :2119-2120). When the sheet sent recorded audio (`recorded` = `_session?.audioPath != null`; `_nativeMode` false: no on-device recognizer, or the online-speech preference) and there are no words, the sheet shows only «Reintentar» (which fails until tomorrow) and «Cancelar» (which discards). Do: (a) Add one private getter, e.g. `bool get _limitWaits`, true when the sheet is resting (idle or paused), the capture is recorded, `!_hasWords`, `_error == CaptureProblem.allowance` and `_previousResult == null`. Treat it exactly as a recording that waits for free dictations: in build (about :2062-2064) make `recordingWaits` also true when `_limitWaits`, so the primary is the existing «Cerrar» FilledButton (`ValueKey('capture-close')`, about :2140) instead of «Reintentar», and `showCancel: !recordingWaits` (about :2398) hides «Cancelar»; and extend `_recordingWaits()` (about :1764) with `|| _limitWaits`, so `_done` and Back close the sheet without asking to discard (about :1868) and the recording stays in Capturas pendientes. (b) The status line must not add «Grabación guardada en este teléfono» (`recordingKept`, the `_ when recorded && !waitsForMore` arm, about :2085) in this state: the banner already says the recording is kept. (c) The banner (about :2306-2313) shows a new key `captureAllowanceRecording` instead of `captureProblemText(l10n, _error!)` when `_limitWaits`: EN “You’ve reached today’s dictation limit. Your recording is kept; try again tomorrow.” / ES «Has llegado al límite de dictados de hoy. Tu grabación se conserva; inténtalo mañana.» / CA «Has arribat al límit de dictats d’avui. La gravació es conserva; torna-ho a provar demà.» (the reviewer's copy, all three languages). @description in app_en.arb: “Capture sheet banner when the daily dictation limit refuses a recording that has no words yet. The only button is Close; the recording stays in Pending captures.” Keep `allowance` as the stored problem value and leave `captureProblemText` unchanged. (d) Organizer's addition, inferred from code, not from the review: a reopened capture restores its stored error (`_problemFor`, about :616-618), so a recording refused yesterday would reopen with only «Cerrar» and could never be retried. On reopen, clear a stored `allowance` (next to where a used-up refusal is cleared, about :620-622), so the reopened recording shows the usual failed state with «Reintentar». If the limit still holds, the refusal comes back and (a)–(c) apply again. (e) With words (typed, or from the phone's recognizer) nothing changes: `captureAllowance` with «Reintentar» and «Guardar como tarea», as P173 built.

UX-1631 (R1A-2, S1). A failed save now reads as a dictation problem: 5xx, timeout or unreachable → «No he podido contactar con el asistente…»; 403 → «Esta cuenta no puede convertir tus palabras en tareas…»; 413 → «Esta grabación es demasiado larga…»; 422 → «No te he entendido…»; 429 → the dictation limit. P173's brief meant only the offline line. Do: in `_apply`'s catch, set `_error = error is ApiException && CaptureProblem.from(error) == CaptureProblem.offline ? CaptureProblem.offline : CaptureProblem.saveFailed;` and replace the comment with one that says only a lost connection says why, and any other failed save says it couldn't add. Timeout is deliberately not kept: it maps to `captureUnavailable`, which speaks of the assistant. Copy stays: ES «Sin conexión. Tus palabras están guardadas; inténtalo cuando tengas internet.» and «No se ha podido añadir. Tus palabras siguen aquí; vuelve a intentarlo.»

Preview: if the preview fakes can open a retained recording (`App/test/ux_previews/support/fakes.dart:55` takes `audioPath`), add `capture/sheet.error-limit-recording` (es 1×, es 2×, ca 2×): a recording with no words answered 429 with Retry-After 3600. If they can't, say so in your notes; the widget tests cover it. Re-render `capture/sheet.` either way.

Tests you may rightly break: none known. The UX-1307 sheet tests in `App/test/capture_sheet_test.dart` (about :2380-2475) use typed words and should keep passing. Harnesses for recordings: `App/test/capture_free_dictations_test.dart` (recordings that wait, «Cerrar» at about :748 and :1035) and `App/test/native_speech_test.dart`; for `_apply`, `App/test/voice_command_cards_test.dart` (about :6745).

Don't touch: `CaptureProblem.from` and its 429 mapping; `captureAllowance`, `captureTooFast` and `captureUnavailable` copy; the free-dictation waiting (`_freeVoice`, `waitsForMore`, `freeVoiceUsedUpText`); P171's control layout; the 16 dp above «Ver lo que dije»; the speed bar.
acceptance: ES, 1× on 360×800, a recording with no words (recorded audio, not the phone's recognizer) answered 429 with Retry-After 3600: the banner reads «Has llegado al límite de dictados de hoy. Tu grabación se conserva; inténtalo mañana.»; the sheet's only button is «Cerrar»; «Reintentar», «Cancelar», «Guardar como tarea» and «Grabación guardada en este teléfono» are not shown. EN and CA show their own copy (“You’ve reached today’s dictation limit. Your recording is kept; try again tomorrow.” / «Has arribat al límit de dictats d’avui. La gravació es conserva; torna-ho a provar demà.»).
In that state, tapping «Cerrar» or Back closes the sheet without the discard question, and the capture is still in the store, listed in Capturas pendientes.
That refused recording, reopened from Capturas pendientes, shows «Reintentar» and not the limit line; when the server then answers, the result shows.
ES, typed words answered 429 with Retry-After 3600: unchanged, «Has llegado al límite de dictados de hoy. Toca Guardar como tarea o inténtalo mañana.» with «Guardar como tarea».

ES, applying a command result whose save fails with each of ApiException 503, status 0 with the timeout message, status 0 with the unreachable message, 403, 413, 422, and 429 with Retry-After 3600: the banner reads «No se ha podido añadir. Tus palabras siguen aquí; vuelve a intentarlo.», and none of `captureUnavailable`, `captureForbidden`, `captureTooLarge`, `captureNoSpeech` or `captureAllowance` shows.
ES, applying a command result while offline (status 0, the offline message): the banner reads «Sin conexión. Tus palabras están guardadas; inténtalo cuando tengas internet.»

Catalog: `captureAllowanceRecording` is in all three ARB files with an @description in app_en.arb, and its EN, ES and CA values contain none of P173's forbidden words (server, service, request; servidor, servicio, solicitud; servidor, servei, sol·licitud).
If the preview was added: ES and CA at 2× on 360×800, `capture/sheet.error-limit-recording` shows the banner whole above «Cerrar», and AUDIT lists no cut text.
deviceChecks: Staging, an account at its daily limit, with online speech on (or no on-device recognizer): a dictation shows the recording line and only «Cerrar»; the recording stays in Capturas pendientes; reopened the next day, «Reintentar» works.

packages.title: Calendar: TalkBack's count for today matches the agenda's
brief: Round 2 (b2). UX-1632 (R1B-1 from P175, S2), not failed before. What P175 built, and review B verified (UX-1408 to UX-1412 fixed): `_weekStrip` (`App/lib/screens/calendar_screen.dart`, from about :440) gives every day a `markerBuilder` (about :558-588) with `Semantics(selected:, value:)`, the value «hoy» for today plus `dayTaskCount(dayTasks.length)`. `dayTasks` comes from `eventLoader` (about :540-543): the day's own open occurrences only. Today's agenda count line (`agendaCounts(total - completed, completed)`, about :890) also counts the overdue tasks it lists (`overdue` and `total`, about :654-667). So AUDIT `calendar/agenda.month` es 1× reads «hoy · 9 tareas», then «10 pendientes · 1 completada». The moment: “It just said 9 tasks today; now it says 10 pending. Which is it?”

Do: move the overdue list into one private helper, e.g. `List<Task> _overdueOn(List<Task> tasks, DateTime now)`: `tasks.map((task) => task.overdueOn(now)).whereType<Task>()`, minus any task already among today's occurrences (`tasks.expand((task) => task.calendarOccurrencesOn(now))`, completed ones included, keyed `'${task.id}:${task.occurrenceId}'` as build's `key` does), sorted as build sorts it today. Build uses it for `overdue` when the selected day is today; the list must come out the same as now. Pass its length to `_weekStrip` (a new named parameter, e.g. `overdueToday`). In `markerBuilder`, today's spoken count is `dayTasks.length + overdueToday`; every other day keeps `dayTasks.length`. Today with no open task of its own and one overdue reads «hoy · 1 tarea». Today's value doesn't depend on which day is selected.

No new strings. Don't change: the dots (still the day's own open tasks, at most 3), the count line, the overdue section, the cell builders and sizes, the arrows, the app bar heading, and anything else P175 built.
acceptance: ES, 1× on 360×800, `calendar/agenda.month` (the fixture with one overdue task): AUDIT reads today's value «hoy · 10 tareas» and the count line «10 pendientes · 1 completada».
Widget, ES, today selected: today's marker value names the same number as the count line's pending tasks, with no overdue task and with one overdue task.
Widget, ES, another day selected: today's marker value still includes the overdue tasks, and reads the same as when today is selected.
Widget, ES: today with no open task of its own and one overdue task reads «hoy · 1 tarea»; a day other than today with one open task still reads «1 tarea».
The dots under today are unchanged: one per open task of the day's own, at most 3.
deviceChecks: Phone with TalkBack and an overdue task: today's day in the strip and the agenda's count line say the same number.
